Decay · Salvage · Beautiful Ruin

Formed from the uncountable dead of the Drowned Coast — every name the sea took and never gave back. She rewards those who leave her small dead things: a broken toy, a spent cartridge casing, a name spoken once and never again. In return, she hands out extraordinary salvage luck. She always collects on the debt, though — a run of bad luck, a bad dream, a favor called in at the worst possible hour.

The favored patron of Scavenger Pattern Scrapwrights, though she'll deal with anyone who brings her something properly, sincerely dead.

Usable setting-wide as a petty-god patron for any class — the Scrapwright is simply the only one with a feat chain built to use her directly.
